payload.claim: This comment says `CellSpec.renames` is 'read by `census_gate` through the suite's `SuiteSpec` protocol', but after this diff `GateSuite._run` also hands `spec.renames` straight to `revert_gate` (saffron/gates/suite.py:202). The comment now understates who consumes this field, which no gate checks since it only judges format/lint/types/tests, and a future reader relying on this comment to gauge the blast radius of changing `renames` would miss `revert_gate`'s now-equal dependence on it.
